known_story_relevant_limitations: What are the names, affiliations and exact fate of the player’s biological parents?
Is the player demonstrably one of the guardian-descendant lines?

What is the complete cross-family causal order of Binh Qua Trung Nguyên?
Can the exact objectives and dialogue for all 77 post-50 wrapper-inline subtasks be recovered without joining unrelated same-ID standalone records?
What is the complete Man Thiên Quá Hải chain beyond the recovered local task node?
Is the unnamed returning woman at Linh Bích definitely Ân Đồng?

build_version_policy: Exact client/server build/version identity is metadata only and is not a promotion requirement unless it changes a MATERIAL story interpretation.
lookup_convention: Resolve IR claim IDs in research/reconciliation/internet-research-claims.jsonl; arc IDs in research/reconstruction/game-story-dossiers/; entity and source record keys in generated/records/. Thread, mystery, relationship and knowledge IDs are source-side handoff projections whose claim_evidence points back to those artifacts.
raw_payload_policy: Raw client/server files, PAKs, binaries, archives, private-input packages and bulk extracted payloads are excluded; provenance references remain textual.
